candidate_relations.reason: The histopathological examination and immunohistochemical studies (S100 positive, GFAP patchy positive, CD34 negative, smooth muscle actin negative, no epithelial components, no mitoses, no atypical cells) are characteristic of a myxoma, not a medulloepithelioma. Medulloepitheliomas are typically epithelial tumors with different cellular characteristics and immunohistochemical profiles.
